title: PreTradeCheckResult
description: Issue #6 portfolio-level gate output. Returned by exec-svc's pre_trade_check Activity. The risk-svc gate fails closed when allowed=false, when buying_power < estimated_notional, when pdt_status='BLOCKED', or when margin_sufficient=false. Broker adapters that do not yet expose a real pre-trade endpoint return allowed=true with sentinel buying_power/pdt fields so the field shape stays stable while implementation backfills land per-provider.

allowed.description: Top-level decision from the broker. If false, the risk gate rejects regardless of the field-level signals. Brokers that cannot decide return true and rely on the field-level checks.

buying_power.description: The broker's cash-affordability basis in dollars at the moment of the check: the funds actually available to fund the order, NOT margin/options buying power. For Alpaca this is the account's available cash, so a margin account (whose options_buying_power is 2-4x cash) cannot lever past its cash. risk-svc rejects when buying_power < estimated_notional.

pdt_status.description: Pattern Day Trader status. OK = entries allowed; FLAGGED = warning only (logged, not gated); BLOCKED = day-trade buying power exhausted, risk-svc rejects.

margin_sufficient.description: Whether the broker reports enough margin for the requested side+qty+notional. risk-svc rejects when false.

reject_reason.description: Optional human-readable reason supplied by the broker when allowed=false or any field-level check fails. Surfaced in audit_log subject for forensics.
